fields.label: Dialog fields (comma-separated)
fields.description: Fieldnames on the target DocType to ask for in a dialog before applying this transition. When set, Condition (if any) is checked against the values entered in the dialog.

fields.label: Comment required
fields.description: Ask for a comment before applying; it is added to the document comments and the notification

fields.label: Apply on edit
fields.description: Not a button: applied automatically when a user with the allowed roles changes the document in the “From” state (e.g. an edited published page goes back to review)

fields.label: Notify (comma-separated)
fields.description: owner — the document author; previous — who performed the previous workflow action; next — users who can take the next step (by role and access to the document)
